target_population: Multiparous women only (birth_order >= 2); impossible for first births by construction
converted_RR_if_applicable: n/a -- not converted from another measure
transportability_note: No literature search was performed. A real source must match: NFHS-5-comparable population, institutional-delivery denominator, facility sector split, parity (multiparous only), and time period -- an all-deliveries or all-parity prevalence cannot be substituted without adjustment.
